name: PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk
summary: PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and trades food and beverages in Indonesia and internationally. It operates two segments, Packaged Foods and Beverages. The company offers biscuits, peanuts, pilus, pellet snacks, confectionery, milk beverages, chocolate powder, cheese, and salad dressing. The company sells its products under the brands Garuda, Gery, Chocolatos, Clevo, Prochiz, Okky, Mountea, and Dilan brand names. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
